items.title: The most common mistake teams make is to treat evals as an additional QA step once the agent is built. AI products are fundamentally different. Your evals are your product spec.
items.title_original: The most common mistake teams make is to treat evals as an additional QA step once the agent is built. AI products are fundamentally different. Your evals are your product spec.
